<thought>The isotopic pattern shows peaks at 1 Da intervals with intensities decreasing roughly 14 % (M+1), 1 % (M+2), 0.07 % (M+3), etc. This matches the natural 13C abundance (~1.1 % per carbon) for a molecule containing about 13 carbons, and no 2 Da spaced patterns characteristic of Cl, Br, or S are present. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the observed isotopic distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
